title: THE PRINCIPAL IS AT OUR DOOR! 🚪
topic: The town's deepest corruption is revealed in the principal's files.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: EVERYBODY GET DOWN [beat] AND STAY AWAY FROM THE WINDOWS RIGHT NOW!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The entire local server just got wiped, [beat] and someone is jamming our signal from the driveway!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Nix, if this is another one of your [beat] internet pranks, you are grounded until you graduate!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: It’s not a prank, you spineless [beat] coward, and I suggest you open this door before the police arrive.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Principal Huda? Why on earth [beat] are you standing on our porch at midnight looking like a fugitive?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Mom, don't open it! [beat] I saw the names on that list and half the town's council is involved in the bribery.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: The digital copies are gone, [beat] but I know your sister Tuli still has the original ledger in her backpack.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: I didn't steal it, I found it in [beat] Mr. Kamal’s desk while I was looking for my graded math essay!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: You found things you weren't [beat] supposed to see, you meddling brat, and now Jamal's reputation is at stake.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Family loyalty is expensive, [beat] but silence is much cheaper if you just hand over the physical evidence.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, Uncle Jamal, you're the one [beat] funding the principal's secret offshore accounts this whole time?

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The hard drive is melting! [beat] Someone is remotely self-destructing every piece of evidence we have left!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The heat in the room was rising, [beat] but the chill in Nix's heart was far more dangerous than the fire.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Look at the last page... [beat] Dad, why is your signature on the bottom of the demolition permit for the school?
